column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/FlashFileSystemTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 16 automatic, 14 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: ported;note:the three fixture writes and the reload write are ASSERTs (the reload write had no message and gets one); the get_file == expected check is an ASSERT on presence then ASSERT_BYTES_EQ; put16, put32 and map_offset come from tests/support/builders/FlashFsRoots.hpp

ported;note:the two fixture writes and the good load are ASSERTs; each && chain is one EXPECT per fact (EXPECT_ERROR Truncated, root_block, version, has_root, blockmap, entry count); the file-data check is presence before and after plus EXPECT_BYTES_EQ

ported;note:each early-returning check is an ASSERT, one per fact (the relocation && chain three); new ASSERT guards on the two stat() results the old test dereferenced unchecked; the readbacks are EXPECT_BYTES_EQ

ported;note:the function called small_block_fs_metadata_matches_dumps (old line 228, 12 check sites) for Small then NewSmall; it is TEST_P FlashFsSmallBlock.MetadataMatchesDumps with rows Small and NewSmall (same order), bundled as nand.Mode/FlashFsSmallBlock; NewSmall is the new hand row; early returns are ASSERTs, the size/page-count && pair two EXPECTs
ported;note:a plain companion of the Mode/FlashFsSmallBlock table, so its own suite (gtest forbids TEST and TEST_P in one suite); the programmed-page && chain is one EXPECT per byte
ported;note:each file check is presence plus EXPECT_BYTES_EQ on value_or

ported;note:the laid loop is an ASSERT on the entry count, which the old test indexed unchecked, then ASSERTs per entry name and block; the early-returning checks are ASSERTs one per fact; the final && chain is an ASSERT on the count then one EXPECT per fact
ported;note:each early-returning check is an ASSERT, one per fact; the stated-value && pairs are one EXPECT per cluster; stated_map_value is file-local
ported;note:the format/allocate/save chain is one ASSERT per call; new ASSERT guards on both stat() results and on a non-empty long.bin chain, which the old test dereferenced unchecked

ported;note:expect_files stays a lambda under SCOPED_TRACE(when), one EXPECT per fact with the old when-suffixed messages; the reserialized chain is ASSERT_OK and an ASSERT on the size before indexing, then one EXPECT per fact; pattern is test::flashfs_pattern, small_root, put_entry and slot_offset come from tests/support/builders/FlashFsRoots.hpp
ported;note:the catch(std::exception) is EXPECT_NO_THROW; the Truncated code and exact message are EXPECT_ERROR_MSG (describe() equals the message: no context); the empty filesystem is two EXPECTs
new;note:the NewSmall call of the small-block metadata helper (old line 285) as its own row
